title: Stream-specific functional and rheological variability in roller-milled wheat flours: a sustainable approach to cookie quality optimization and flour utilization
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6FB00108D, Paper

Distinct break and reduction flour streams showed contrasting hydration, rheological, and thermal behaviors, enabling targeted flour blending for improved cookie quality, resource-efficient processing, and sustainable stream utilization.
